title: Heterogeneous Dependency Graph-Guided Attentionfor Patent Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.10073v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pre-trained language models advance patent classification and retrieval by encoding claims as flat token sequences, but they overlook the dependency hierarchy among claims. Incorporating this hierarchy into self-attention poses two challenges. First, claim dependencies include relation types with different levels of reliability, so treating them uniformly may allow noisy technical relations to interfere with more reliable legal citations. Second, claim dependencies are defined at the claim level, whereas Transformer attention operates over tokens, making direct structural injection nontrivial. We propose the Patent Heterogeneous Attention-Guided Graph Encoder (PHAGE), which constructs a typed claim graph that distinguishes legal citations from technical relations. translated_title: 异构依赖图引导注意力用于专利表示学习
translated_abstract: 预训练语言模型通过将权利要求编码为扁平的词元序列，推动了专利分类与检索任务的发展，但它们忽略了权利要求之间的依赖层级结构。将这种层级结构融入自注意力机制面临两大挑战：其一，权利要求依赖关系包含可靠性程度不同的多种关系类型，若不加区分地统一处理，可能使嘈杂的技术性关系干扰更可靠的法律引用关系；其二，权利要求依赖关系定义在权利要求层面，而Transformer注意力机制作用于词元层面，使得直接注入结构信息并非易事。我们提出了专利异构注意力引导图编码器，该方法构建了一个类型化的权利要求图，将法律引用与技术关系区分开来。PHAGE通过连通性掩码和可学习的关系感知偏置，将权利要求层面的拓扑结构投影到词元层面的注意力中，并使用双重策略对编码器进行微调。
tldr: 提出PHAGE模型，通过构建区分法律引用与技术关系的类型化权利要求异构图，并借助连通性掩码和可学习的关系感知偏置将权利要求级依赖拓扑注入词元级注意力，从而提升专利表示学习的效果。
en_tdlr: PHAGE constructs a typed claim graph that distinguishes legal citations from technical relations, and injects claim-level dependency topology into token-level attention via connectivity masks and learnable relation-aware biases to improve patent representation learning.
